_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/test_delayed_trigger_subject.py. t_dsub_insight is Hunter's Insight: choose target creature you control, then a delayed subscription scoped to THAT creature. t_dsub_any is the same spell with no subject, the control that shows what an unscoped subscription does -- it fires for every creature you control, which is Forth Eorlingas! and a different card. The two bears are interchangeable so the scope is the only thing separating them.

cards.name: Test Hunter's Insight
cards.oracle_text: Choose target creature you control. Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player this turn, draw that many cards.

spell_effects.text: Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player this turn, draw that many cards.

cards.name: Test Unscoped Insight
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player this turn, draw that many cards.
